item.title: Observable Framework: a new open-source static site generator to get data past the last mile
item.description: Data teams often have established workflows to access data from different sources, process, and analyze data, but can be stymied by the “last mile problem” in data: creating rich, fast, and fully customized apps and dashboards. Closed-source, GUI-based BI options pose challenges for data visualization developers, restricting them to pre-built data integrations, out-of-the-box chart components and layouts, and restricted publishing options. Observable Framework is a new open-source static site generator, command line tool, and local preview server.
